**Subject: Overdue Invoice #[Number], Payment Required**

Dear [Client Name],

I hope you're well. Our records show that invoice #[Number] for [amount], due on [due date], is now 30 days overdue. I've attached a copy for your reference.

Please arrange payment by [specific date, e.g., 7 days from now]. If payment has already been sent, please share the transaction details so we can update our records.

If there's an issue with the invoice or you need to discuss a payment arrangement, please contact me right away so we can resolve it promptly.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Company Name]
[Phone] | [Email]
